title: B2Gold Announces Renewal of Normal Course Issuer Bid
summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, April 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - B2Gold Corp. (TSX: BTO) (NYSE American: BTG) ( B2Gold or the Company ) announces that the Toronto Stock Exchange (the TSX ) has accepted the notice of B2Golds intention to renew its normal course issuer bid (the NCIB ). The Companys decision to renew the NCIB is consistent with its shareholder return strategy, and reflective of the Company's belief that the market may undervalue the common shares of B2Gold (the Shares ) from time to time and that the Shares may trade in a price range which may not adequately reflect the value of the Shares in relation to the business, assets, and prospects of B2Gold from time to time and that purchases of Shares pursuant to the NCIB may represent an appropriate and desirable use of the Companys capital.
